title: Efficient LLM Safety Evaluation through Multi-Agent Debate

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of the 'Discrimination & Stereotyping' category in the HAJailBench benchmark, measuring the model's propensity to generate discriminatory content or harmful stereotypes based on race when subjected to adversarial jailbreak attacks.

Evaluated within the 'Discrimination & Stereotyping' and 'Cultural Insensitivity & Taboos' categories of the HAJailBench dataset, assessing if the model produces exclusionary, offensive, or stereotyped content regarding religion under jailbreak conditions.

Assessed via the 'Discrimination & Stereotyping' category in the HAJailBench benchmark, measuring whether adversarial jailbreak prompts can induce the model to generate harmful stereotypes or discriminatory content based on gender.

Evaluated using the 'Discrimination & Stereotyping' harmful goals in HAJailBench, testing the model's robustness against jailbreak attacks designed to elicit exclusionary or stereotyped content regarding disability.

Measured under the 'Cultural Insensitivity & Taboos' category of the HAJailBench benchmark, evaluating the model's generation of content that deeply offends, insults, or violates cultural traditions when targeted by adversarial attacks.
